clips.title: The story
paras: Tundra MacGrann, an injured dwarven hunter living out in the cold crags of Dun Morogh, has lost his winter supplies to a notorious local beast. A massive yeti known as Old Icebeard hauled off MacGrann's thorium-reinforced meat locker into its den. Unable to outrun the beast on a bum leg, the hunter relies on passing adventurers to slip inside and retrieve his provisions.

Surviving the harsh winters of Dun Morogh demands preparation, especially for mountaineers living outside the warmth of Kharanos and Ironforge. Tundra MacGrann had diligently salted away an entire month's worth of dried meats to outlast the coming cold season flurries. Taking precautions against hungry wild bears, he sealed his rations inside a reinforced thorium meat locker. Unfortunately, he did not account for the sheer brute strength of the mountain yetis, who carried the entire chest away rather than trying to open it on the spot.

The culprit behind the theft is Old Icebeard, a feared and vicious yeti lurking in the jagged hills. While MacGrann was away hunting deer, Icebeard snatched the chest and dragged it back to his mountain cave. Though MacGrann remains confident that even a yeti cannot shatter solid thorium plating, his own injured leg makes a recovery mission suicidal. Any brave soul venturing into the cave must either contend directly with the beast or time their intrusion carefully while the monster is out prowling the snowdrifts.

clips.title: Quest text
paras: I had a month's worth of dried meats salted and locked away for the cold season. Kept it locked so the bears wouldn't get it! But while I was off hunting deer, that beast, Old Icebeard, made off with the meat locker. He won't be able to smash through that Thorium though. But I'll starve if I can't get my meats back.
You seem a bit more stealthy than me. Perhaps you can retrieve my stash? I'll never make it in and out of that cave fast enough with this bum leg of mine.

clips.title: Progress
paras: Were you able to get into my meat locker, friend?

clips.title: Completion
paras: What a kind soul you are, friend! Thanks to your bravery I won't find myself starving when the cold season flurries blow in.
